gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-inika: Distinctive lettering up top, round and bent like wire, with Cherry Swash taking the lead. Inika is a text serif with see-through gaps in every s, and it can sit a notch smaller than the heading without losing ground.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-kay-pho-du: Kay Pho Du writes with the hollow, single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen. Cherry Swash is the loud one here, a display heading with a horseshoe-wide c, and the serif below simply lets it talk.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-labrada: Dignified and bookish, Labrada keeps its small letters wide open. Cherry Swash, drawn like a neon sign tube at a single track width, makes the sharpest contrast with that quiet serif.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-montaga: Thread stitched along a path. Montaga lifts its pen before loops close, so Cherry Swash gets the swagger while the classic serif lets paragraphs unspool in a bookish, editorial murmur.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-new-tegomin: New Tegomin offers a c like a wide-open ring. Cherry Swash, cut with strokes like a fixed-width router bit, takes the headline spot while the serif below stays dignified and traditional.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-rhodium-libre: Heavy diagonals and a horseshoe c mark Cherry Swash. Its thick-only outline earns its keep big and brief, while Rhodium Libre, a classic serif with lifted brush ends, handles the rest.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-rokkitt: Cherry Swash bends its lines like a paperclip, with no thick-to-thin shifts at all, and that is its whole attitude. Rokkitt, a serif with a similarly open c, carries a bookish, traditional page without fuss.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sanchez: Bookish and dignified, Sanchez reads like a classic serif with a c opened like calipers. Cherry Swash, a plain stripe of constant ink, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-solway: Stencil-flat lines with a loud personality up top, courtesy of Cherry Swash and its horseshoe c. Solway, a classic serif with a generous entry into the e, feels authoritative beside it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-yuji-boku: A horseshoe c and heavy diagonals give Cherry Swash its swagger, and it commands the top of the page. Yuji Boku, a classic serif with cable-like strokes, is editorial and dignified.
